verify_points.desc: One command verifies a v2 composition and emits machine-readable ok/errors/warnings.
The report includes an ASCII timeline that lets AI inspect track timing without screenshots.
The report flags layout/text risks such as missing x/y, out-of-bounds layout, long text, and estimated overlap.
The report produces typical screenshot capture points so visual review is repeatable.

ai_tools.command: NEXTFRAME_HOME=examples target/debug/nf verify --project v2-showcase --composition showreel-24s --out ../NextFrame.archive/v0.19.0-verify/showreel-verify.json | jq '.ok, .summary.errors'
